rows.en:
(Today she asked me, "Want to go up
to the roof for a change?" but...)

\p-kun!
Over here, over here~
Oh, okay.
rows.notes: x3, player; also nml_she_016 (Sheryl: 'wait a moment').

rows.en: Sorry for dragging you to a place like this...

No, the view's nice.
The roof's a great spot.

Right? Whenever I've got something on my mind,
I come up here alone and look at the sky,
and it all just empties out.

Huh~
But then isn't it bad for me to be here?

No, today I was hoping we could
talk about all sorts of things up here...
Hey, do you have a dream or anything...?

Hm?
...A dream, huh...

Me, I've never really been able to think
about the future at all...

I'd vaguely think, "I want to be
like Claire-senpai,"
rows.notes: x2, Akimizu; sentence runs over c15376-c15378.

rows.en: or "I want to become a real operator,"

all kinds of things, but it was all
kind of hazy, you know?

Like, "Where is this Macross
going to end up?"
rows.notes: x2, Akimizu; sentence runs over c15379-c15382 (the haziness explained by other worries). Macross = the colony ship.

rows.en: or "When will that be?"

or "Will we even find a planet
we can live on?"

I figured it was because I had
so many other worries like those, you know?
But lately, things feel a little different.

Little by little, I've been trying all kinds
of things on my own, and it's all so fresh
and fun that I lose track of time...

And I feel like I'm sort of starting to see
"what I want to do"...
Yeah, that's great!

And I think it's mostly thanks to the two
years I've spent here at Mihoshi.
I see. I've still got a long way to go...
Maybe it's thanks to you?

No, never mind. I hope you find yours too,
\p-kun...
Yeah. So what's your dream, Akimizu?
Hmm~ It's still a secret!
Whaaat~!
rows.notes: x6: player here; also Hoshimura (nml_yui_016) and the player (scd_skl_609).

rows.en:
Okay, the wind's picking up,
so let's head down!
Huh? Hey, wait~...
(Akimizu's dream... I wonder what it is...)

\p-chan!
Over here, over here~

No, the view's nice.
The roof's a great spot.

Huh~
But then isn't it bad for me to be here?
Wow~ That's great!
I see~ I've still got a long way to go...

No, never mind. I hope you find yours too,
\p-chan...
Yeah. So what's your dream, Yuu?
Geez, hang on a sec~
(Yuu's dream... I wonder what it is.)
(Akimizu called me up to the roof again, but...)
What's going on, up here again?
Yeah, I just felt like talking a little again...

Ahh, talking it out made me feel
so much better!
I see. That's good, then!
Thanks for listening to me.
Hey, if that's all it is, anytime.

Then I'll call you up here every single day!
Just kidding!
(I guess I'm glad Akimizu cheered up.)
(Yuu called me up to the roof again, but...)
I see. I'm glad!
No problem. If that's all it is, anytime.
(I'm glad Yuu cheered up.)

(Central Park today, huh...
I'm pretty sure we met up here before, too...)
rows.notes: Male, frd_yuu_008; refers to frd_yuu_002 (the park).

rows.en: (Come to think of it, that time...)
Whoa, you're early!
Huh?! What's wrong?

No, I was just thinking about the last time
we met here... You showed up pretty late
that time, Akimizu~

Ahh, right...
I'm really sorry about that time...
Nah, that was over a year ago.

Wow, it's already been over a year
since then...

Time flies, huh.
We've moved up a year,
so graduation's just a year away.

Isn't it a little early to be talking
about graduating?
Hahaha, true.

Oh, I made lunch again today.
You'll have some, right?

Yeah! It's been a while since I had
your home cooking, Akimizu.

Ahh, delicious as always.
You'll make a great wife someday, Akimizu.
Hehehe, that's the classic line, isn't it?

And this is where you say,
"Oh? Whose wife?" Right?

Then would you answer,
"Mine, of course"?
Pfft...
Heh...
Ahahahahaha!
rows.notes: x2, both the male player and Akimizu.

rows.en: Just kidding!
Geez, you don't hold back, Akimizu.
But that might be nice too!

Oh, I mean the "great wife" part!
Yeah, that's it.
rows.notes: Akimizu, male scene; backpedals to 'becoming a wife', not 'his'.

rows.en: Oh, is that all...

Oh, but there's something
I want to do before that.
rows.notes: Akimizu, male scene; continues into slice 211.
